EXHIBIT A
PLAINTIFE’S THREE PROPOSED INTERROGATORIES TO NCMEC

Pursuant to the accompanying Motion under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(d)(1),
Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine propounds the following three interrogatories to Defendant
National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (““NCMEC”), to be answered under oath
pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 33. NCMEC shall answer each interrogatory only:
“Yes,” “No,” or “Unable to determine after reasonable inquiry.” The interrogatories seek no

explanation and no report content.

INTERROGATORY NO. 1: Excluding information supplied by Plaintiff in the
April 9, 2026 materials, court filings, public sources, and information obtained or
added after original receipt by NCMEC, did either of the two CyberTipline reports
referenced in NCMEC’s April 22, 2026 letters, as originally received by NCMEC,
contain or otherwise identify “Marvelle J. Ballentine”?
